bullets.bullet_text: Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing governance programs, structuring traceable scenario architectures, challenger models, and model-risk remediation frameworks that delivered audit-ready evidence across regulated financial institutions.

Led quantitative derivatives and insurance-capital modernization initiatives, applying exotic options pricing, liability Greek hedging, and higher-order stress testing to strengthen capital adequacy and hedge-design rigor for insurers.

Architected enterprise risk-governance operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk-data aggregation controls across business units.
